title: Russell 2000 Leads Stocks Today Again; Will This China Internet Stock Breakout Succeed? - Investor's Business Daily
text:
DAVID SAITO-CHUNG 2:30 PM ET
The Russell 2000 showed on Thursday that stocks today remain in a confirmed uptrend, at one point rising more than 0.6%. But the general market stumbled lower in afternoon trading on news reports that President Trump expressed doubt that the U.S. will make concrete progress in ongoing trade talks with China. X
Even as the major indexes deflated, market breadth remained positive. On the Nasdaq, winners beat losers by a 4-3 margin. On the NYSE, winners led by roughly 100 issues. And, at the Russell 2000's session high of 1627, the popular gauge of small-cap stocks is up almost 6% through nearly five months of trading in 2018.
China's Baozun ( BZUN ), a small-cap e-commerce expert, cleared a 52.43 buy point in a new base . Shares reached as high as 53.90, up 19.5%, before pulling back some.
Baozun has already seen 11 million shares exchange hands, more than double its float of 19 million. The stock trades on average 2.6 million shares a day.
Baozun ranks No. 8 in IBD's current Global Leaders Stock List .
At 2:30 p.m., the Russell 2000 advanced 0.4%. The Nasdaq composite and the Dow Jones industrial average slumped around 0.3%. The S&P 500 edged down 0.2%. ( For more updates on stocks today , please check IBD's Stock Market Today section, found beneath "Market Trend" on the homepage of Investors.com. )
Volume is mixed, running lower vs. the same time Wednesday on the Nasdaq but higher on the NYSE. How Are FAANGs Doing?
Apple ( AAPL ), meanwhile, shows that the FAANG stocks shouldn't be ignored either.
The iPhone, iPad and digital services titan is not participating in the market's upside, but the nearly 0.6% decline in superdull volume (apologies for the stock-market-style oxymoron) is actually a good thing for Apple investors. Why? The stock is making a quiet pullback after thrusting nicely past a new buy point: 179.04, 10 cents above the 178.94 middle peak within a double-bottom base .
The double bottom is one of seven critical chart patterns that every savvy growth stock investor can use to build positions at the precise moment that a true market leader breaks past historical price-resistance levels and ramps to a series of new highs.
On Jan. 6, 2017, Apple initially broke out of a first-stage cup with handle that furnished a 118.12 correct buy point . IBD's Stock Market Today feature covered that breakout in real time as well as the setup of that key juncture in the stock's current turnaround story. Hot Baozun
Baozun, featured frequently in Investors.com and IBD Weekly over the past few years, helps multinational companies gain inroads into the Chinese consumer market. You can read more about what Baozun does in a June New America article .
The stock has 19 million shares in the float and 55 million shares outstanding. The market value is just under $3 billion. Early on Thursday, Baozun posted a 29% increase in earnings to 9 cents a share . The first quarter appears to be one of Baozun's seasonally slowest periods. But that 29% EPS gain also comes on top of a 75% jump to 7 cents in the year-ago quarter.
First-quarter revenue rose 25% to $146.4 million, the highest for any first quarter in the company's history. That result is almost the same as Baozun's full-year revenue in 2012.
Keep in mind that the stock swings much more wildly than any S&P 500 firm. Thursday's breakout past a 52.43 buy point is from a late-stage pattern . This does not mean the breakout won't work. But the risk of a negative reversal and a breakout failure is higher.
Baozun initially broke out of a long, deep, first-stage cup base near 10 in late August of 2016. Time To Play Defense, Sell Cisco?
Elsewhere in stocks today, Cisco Systems ( CSCO ) gapped down at the open and slid more than 3% to 43.56. The Nasdaq tech giant undercut its 50-day moving average and is now nearly 6% below a 46.26 buy point in a cup without handle .
That decline is not enough to execute the golden rule of investing .
Watch to see if the data networking pioneer can hold up close to and eventually retake the 50-day line. As reported by IBD earlier today, Cisco has announced a huge new stock-buyback plan .
For those who bought at the 46.26 entry, investors would have to cut losses at 8%, or when Cisco hits 42.56. A New Commodity Play
Lithium miner Sociedad Quimica y Minera ( SQM ) dropped more than 4% to 55.24 in volume running nearly triple normal levels. Yet the sell-off does not wreck the current work on a new base being formed by the Chilean company.
On April 5, Sociedad Quimica gapped up bullishly in price, leading to an eventual retaking of the 50-day moving average. That's a good sign. It means institutional investors are getting greedy again, showing renewed demand for shares.
The Street sees SQM's earnings rising 10% to $1.80 a share this year and 17% in 2019. Over the past six quarters, earnings have lifted 320%, 82%, 77%, 19%, 105% and 35% vs. year-ago levels.
That impressive record meets the C factor in CAN SLIM , IBD's seven-point paradigm for growth investing. The C refers to the quality of current earnings growth.
